race.comment: Tricky race. SPOT THE GREY (7) got off the mark over 1500m at this track last start, scoring by 1.5 lengths. That was his 23 start so perhaps tread carefully but if he can go on with it now he's a chance for the double. VALIDATED (1) wound up strongly last time out to finish 1.3 lengths adrift in second over 1400m at this track. Settles back early but winds up late. This looks no tougher and he should take holding out. CUBAN DAWN (8) caught the eye last start over 1400m at Bendigo, coming from well back to finish half a length from the winner in second. Peaks now third up and should be right there. ISDELL (5) finished fourth over 1400m at this track last time out following a determined win two runs back. Tough draw but is in the mix.
